properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL — from the `proj:bhome` feedback report, 2026-08-31. Nothing chosen.

═══ WHAT WAS OBSERVED ═══
On a design of 55 nodes, `detect_defects` returned six findings. THREE OF THE SIX WERE NODES REFLOW2'S OWN TOOLS HAD CREATED:
· TWO `Question` nodes flagged `orphan_node` — including one still awaiting the user's answer. `gap_to_prompt` creates Questions as a side effect of the intended handshake, so FOLLOWING THE DOCUMENTED WORKFLOW RELIABLY MANUFACTURES THESE.
· `epoch:genesis` flagged `orphan_node` — created by the `genesis` tool and attached to nothing by any documented step.

The reporter's reading, and it is the right one: they are `info` severity, which is correct, "but they dilute a six-item list down to four real items, and the fix (park it against an accepted Decision) is disproportionate ceremony for a record the tool created itself."

⭐ THE OTHER THREE WERE GENUINELY REAL, which is what makes the dilution worth fixing rather than shrugging at. Both `unthreaded_cluster` warnings were true edges the agent had simply failed to draw — the satellite link needs electricity, and transportability relates to the core-plus-site-kits split. "Neither was a false positive." A detector whose real findings are outnumbered by its own scaffolding is being taught to be ignored.

🛑 THIS IS THE FAILURE MODE THIS PROJECT HAS ALREADY NAMED TWICE AND DESIGNED AGAINST TWICE. `swept.parked` and `ruling: parks` exist precisely so "a count that grows when somebody does the right thing" stops teaching people to stop reading it — and the environment-domain parking decision says so in as many words. The mechanism exists; it is the SCAFFOLDING that has not been put behind it.

═══ A FOURTH, SAME FAMILY ═══
`build_without_verification` fired on a project with NO ARTIFACTS AT ALL. Technically correct and, as filed, "arrives earlier than it is useful" — a design that has not built anything yet is not a design that failed to verify what it built.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
① THE CREATING TOOL PARKS ITS OWN NODE. `gap_to_prompt` and `genesis` draw the `governed_by(ruling: parks)` edge themselves at creation. Uses the mechanism that already exists, costs one edge, and the node stays visible and counted in `swept.parked` rather than hidden.
② EXCLUDE PROVENANCE-SHAPED TYPES FROM `orphan_node`. Question and DesignEpoch are records ABOUT the design rather than parts of it — the topology rules already drop provenance types from the design network for exactly this reason, and `orphan_node` walks the full 55 rather than the narrower 52. Arguably the rule's population is simply wrong.
③ SUPPRESS `build_without_verification` WHEN THE ARTIFACT COUNT IS ZERO — a precondition, not a threshold.
④ DO NOTHING. They are `info`, they are correct, and a reader who understands the tool can skip them.

⚠️ COUNTER-ARGUMENTS. (1) A Question genuinely IS attached to nothing until it is answered, so the finding is TRUE — the complaint is about proportion, not correctness, and suppressing true findings to improve a ratio is how a detector starts lying. (2) ② risks the opposite error: if provenance types are dropped from `orphan_node`, a Question that SHOULD have been wired to its gap becomes invisible. (3) None of this was measured beyond one 55-node design, and the ratio that looks bad at six findings may be negligible at sixty.
properties.name: OPEN — three of six defects on a new design were nodes reflow2's own tools created; following the documented path reliably manufactures orphan findings
properties.rationale: Recorded under the brainstorm discipline — ideas as ideas, nothing promoted. Kept separate from the sibling idea about inline linking because they are different questions with different answers: that one is about the cost of the capture path, this one is about a detector's signal-to-noise on a young design. Merging them would produce a node that can only be half-answered.
